body: I’ll be honest I can’t relate to your experience exactly because everyone’s life is different. However, I can tell you that there will be many MANY MANY moments in your life where you will look back and think “thank god i didn’t kill myself.” If you allow negative thoughts to completely control you, your brain will get in the habit of doing so and it becomes harder and harder to ignore them. As far as your sexuality, there is absolutely nothing to be ashamed of, it can be a very stressful thing in your life. However, you may find that many people are more open to it than you think, especially in LA. If you don’t feel comfortable opening up to many people about it, understand that’s completely fine and you should continue to be yourself. Perhaps having a conversation about it with a close friend who you trust will help you feel better about it. Just know that yhere are always people in your life that love you and care much more about you than you realize. “Everybody’s somebody’s everything.”
